# ElevateMe

> ElevateMe is a U.S. Talent Intelligence Marketplace that connects employers and recruiters with verified, role-matched graduate, post-graduate and professional talent, while helping candidates become genuinely hire-ready. It is not a traditional job board — matching is based on verified skills, real project evidence and readiness scores rather than self-reported resumes.

ElevateMe focuses exclusively on graduate, post-graduate and professional careers across Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Product, Design, Finance, Marketing, Business and Healthcare. It does not cover blue-collar or skilled-trade roles.

## Career guides
- [Data Analyst](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/data-analyst) — A Data Analyst collects, cleans and interprets data to help organizations make decisions. They write SQL queries, build dashboards and translate business questions into measurable insights using tools like SQL, Python, Excel and BI platforms such as Power BI or Tableau.
- [Data Scientist](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/data-scientist) — A Data Scientist builds statistical and machine-learning models to predict outcomes and uncover patterns. They combine programming (usually Python), statistics and domain knowledge to design experiments, train models and deliver measurable business impact.
- [Backend Engineer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/backend-engineer) — A Backend Engineer builds the servers, APIs and data layers that power applications. They design reliable, scalable services — commonly with languages like Python and frameworks like FastAPI — and work with databases such as PostgreSQL and cloud platforms like AWS.
- [Frontend Engineer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/frontend-engineer) — A Frontend Engineer builds the user-facing part of web applications. They turn designs into fast, accessible, interactive interfaces using JavaScript and frameworks like React, and work closely with designers and backend engineers.
- [Full-Stack Engineer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/full-stack-engineer) — A Full-Stack Engineer works across both the frontend and backend of an application. They can build an entire feature end to end — UI, API and database — and are valued for versatility on small teams.
- [DevOps Engineer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/devops-engineer) — A DevOps Engineer automates how software is built, tested and deployed. They manage cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines and monitoring so teams can ship reliably and often.
- [Cloud Engineer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/cloud-engineer) — A Cloud Engineer designs, builds and manages an organization's cloud environment. They provision infrastructure, control cost and security, and enable teams to run applications on platforms like AWS, Azure or GCP.
- [Machine Learning Engineer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/ml-engineer) — A Machine Learning Engineer takes models built by data scientists and makes them production-ready. They build training pipelines, serve models at scale and monitor them in the real world.
- [AI Engineer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/ai-engineer) — An AI Engineer builds applications powered by artificial intelligence — especially large language models and generative AI. They design prompts, fine-tune and evaluate models, and ship AI features into production responsibly.
- [Data Engineer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/data-engineer) — A Data Engineer builds and maintains the pipelines and infrastructure that move and shape data at scale. They make clean, reliable data available for analytics and machine learning.
- [Cybersecurity Analyst](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/cybersecurity-analyst) — A Cybersecurity Analyst protects an organization's systems and data from threats. They monitor for attacks, investigate incidents, and put controls in place to reduce risk.
- [QA Engineer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/qa-engineer) — A QA (Quality Assurance) Engineer makes sure software works as intended before it reaches users. They design test plans, write automated tests and catch defects early.
- [BI Analyst](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/bi-analyst) — A Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst designs and maintains the dashboards, data models and reporting a business runs on. They turn raw data into reliable, self-serve reporting using tools like Power BI, Tableau and SQL.
- [Business Analyst](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/business-analyst) — A Business Analyst bridges business needs and technical solutions. They gather requirements, map processes and translate stakeholder goals into clear specifications for analytics, product or systems teams.
- [Project Manager](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/project-manager) — A Project Manager plans, coordinates and delivers projects on time and on budget. They manage scope, timelines, resources and risk while keeping stakeholders aligned.
- [Product Manager](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/product-manager) — A Product Manager decides what a product team builds and why. They talk to users, prioritize a roadmap, and work with engineering and design to ship features that solve real problems.
- [Operations Manager](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/operations-manager) — An Operations Manager keeps a business running smoothly. They oversee day-to-day processes, people and budgets, and continuously improve how work gets done.
- [Management Consultant](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/management-consultant) — A Management Consultant helps organizations solve high-stakes business problems. They analyze data, structure recommendations and support clients through strategy, operations or transformation work.
- [Accountant](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/accountant) — An Accountant prepares and reviews financial records to keep an organization compliant and informed. They handle the books, reconcile accounts and support reporting and tax.
- [Financial Analyst](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/financial-analyst) — A Financial Analyst turns numbers into decisions. They build models, analyze performance and forecast results to guide budgeting, investment and strategy.
- [Auditor](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/auditor) — An Auditor independently reviews financial records and controls to confirm they are accurate and compliant. They identify risk and recommend improvements.
- [Registered Nurse](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/registered-nurse) — A Registered Nurse (RN) provides and coordinates patient care. They assess patients, administer treatments and medications, and educate patients and families across hospitals, clinics and community settings.
- [Physical Therapist](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/physical-therapist) — A Physical Therapist helps patients recover movement and manage pain after injury, surgery or illness. They assess mobility and design personalized treatment plans.
- [Healthcare Administrator](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/healthcare-administrator) — A Healthcare Administrator manages the business side of clinics, hospitals and health systems. They oversee operations, staffing, compliance and budgets so care can be delivered well.
- [Sales Representative](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/sales-representative) — A Sales Representative sells products or services to customers. They find prospects, understand needs, and close deals while building lasting relationships.
- [Account Executive](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/account-executive) — An Account Executive owns the full sales cycle for larger deals. They run discovery, demos and negotiations to close revenue and grow key accounts.
- [Sales Manager](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/sales-manager) — A Sales Manager leads and coaches a sales team to hit revenue targets. They set strategy, manage pipeline and develop reps.
- [Digital Marketing Specialist](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/digital-marketing-specialist) — A Digital Marketing Specialist plans and runs campaigns across channels like search, social, email and paid ads. They use data to attract and convert customers.
- [Content Writer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/content-writer) — A Content Writer creates written content — articles, guides, emails and web copy — that informs audiences and supports marketing goals.
- [Social Media Manager](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/social-media-manager) — A Social Media Manager builds and grows a brand's presence across social platforms. They plan content, engage audiences and measure impact.
- [SEO Specialist](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/seo-specialist) — An SEO Specialist helps websites rank higher in search engines. They research keywords, improve technical health and create content strategies that drive organic traffic.
- [Graphic Designer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/graphic-designer) — A Graphic Designer creates visual content — logos, layouts, ads and brand assets — that communicates ideas clearly and beautifully.
- [UX Designer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/ux-designer) — A UX Designer makes products easy and enjoyable to use. They research users, design flows and wireframes, and test solutions to improve the experience.
- [Product Designer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/product-designer) — A Product Designer owns the end-to-end design of digital products — from research and UX to polished UI — working closely with product and engineering.
- [HR Generalist](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/hr-generalist) — An HR Generalist supports the full employee lifecycle — hiring, onboarding, benefits, relations and compliance — keeping the workplace fair and effective.
- [Recruiter](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/recruiter) — A Recruiter finds, attracts and hires talent. They source candidates, run interviews and manage the process for both candidates and hiring managers.
- [HR Manager](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/hr-manager) — An HR Manager leads the people function for a team or company. They set HR strategy, manage a team, and handle complex employee and compliance matters.
- [Supply Chain Analyst](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/supply-chain-analyst) — A Supply Chain Analyst uses data to keep goods moving efficiently. They analyze demand, inventory and logistics to reduce cost and avoid shortages.
- [Teacher](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/teacher) — A Teacher educates and supports students in a subject or grade level. They plan lessons, assess learning and create an environment where students can grow.
- [Instructional Designer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/instructional-designer) — An Instructional Designer creates effective learning experiences. They design courses, e-learning and materials grounded in how people actually learn.
- [Corporate Trainer](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/corporate-trainer) — A Corporate Trainer teaches employees the skills they need to succeed. They design and deliver training on tools, processes, compliance and soft skills.
- [Customer Success Manager](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/careers/customer-success-manager) — A Customer Success Manager (CSM) makes sure customers get value from a product so they stay and grow. They onboard, advise and advocate for their accounts.

## University program guides
- [Careers for Computer Science graduates](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/programs/computer-science) — A Computer Science degree opens doors to some of the most in-demand and highest-paid careers in the U.S. — from software and backend engineering to AI, machine learning, cloud and cybersecurity. Graduates are valued for problem-solving, systems thinking and the ability to build and scale technology.
- [Careers for Data Science graduates](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/programs/data-science) — A Data Science degree prepares graduates to turn data into insight and intelligent products. It leads to careers in data science, machine learning, AI, analytics and data engineering across nearly every industry.
- [Careers for Information Technology graduates](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/programs/information-technology) — An Information Technology degree leads to careers building, running and securing the systems organizations depend on — cloud, DevOps, security, quality and data.
- [Careers for Cybersecurity graduates](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/programs/cybersecurity) — A Cybersecurity degree prepares graduates to protect organizations from evolving digital threats — a field with strong demand and a widening talent gap.
- [Careers for Business Administration (MBA) graduates](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/programs/business-administration) — A Business Administration degree or MBA is one of the most versatile qualifications, leading to leadership careers in product, consulting, operations, strategy and general management across every industry.
- [Careers for Finance & Accounting graduates](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/programs/finance) — A Finance or Accounting degree leads to analytical, high-responsibility careers in financial analysis, accounting, auditing, consulting and corporate strategy.
- [Careers for Marketing & Communications graduates](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/programs/marketing) — A Marketing or Communications degree leads to creative, data-driven careers in digital marketing, content, social media, SEO and brand growth.
- [Careers for Design & Human-Computer Interaction graduates](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/programs/design) — A Design or HCI degree leads to careers shaping how people experience products — from UX and product design to visual and brand design.

## Skill guides
- [SQL](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/sql) — SQL (Structured Query Language) is the standard language for querying and managing relational databases. It is one of the most requested skills for data, analytics and engineering roles, used to extract, join, filter and aggregate data.
- [Python](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/python) — Python is a versatile programming language widely used across data analysis, machine learning and backend development. Its readable syntax and rich ecosystem make it a foundational skill for technical roles.
- [Excel](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/excel) — Microsoft Excel is the world's most widely used tool for organizing, analyzing and reporting data. From formulas and pivot tables to models, it's essential across finance, operations, analytics and business roles.
- [Power BI](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/power-bi) — Power BI is Microsoft's business intelligence platform for building interactive dashboards and reports. Analysts use it to model data, write DAX measures and share self-serve reporting.
- [Tableau](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/tableau) — Tableau is a leading data-visualization platform used to explore data and build interactive dashboards. It's popular in analytics and BI roles for its drag-and-drop visual analysis.
- [JavaScript](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/javascript) — JavaScript is the programming language of the web. It powers interactive websites and applications and is the foundation for frameworks like React.
- [React](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/react) — React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces. It's one of the most in-demand frontend skills, used to build interactive, component-based web applications.
- [FastAPI](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/fastapi) — FastAPI is a modern, high-performance Python web framework for building APIs. It offers automatic validation and docs and is widely used for backend services and ML model serving.
- [AWS](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/aws) — Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the most widely adopted cloud platform. Engineers use it to deploy, scale and operate applications and data pipelines.
- [Docker](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/docker) — Docker packages applications into portable containers that run the same everywhere. It's a core skill for modern deployment and DevOps.
- [Machine Learning](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/machine-learning) — Machine Learning is the practice of building systems that learn patterns from data to make predictions. It underpins data science and AI roles.
- [Data Visualization](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/data-visualization) — Data Visualization is the skill of presenting data clearly and persuasively through charts and dashboards so people can understand and act on it.
- [Project Management](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/project-management) — Project Management is the skill of planning and delivering work on time and on budget. It spans scope, schedule, risk and stakeholder management across every industry.
- [Agile & Scrum](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/agile-scrum) — Agile and Scrum are ways of organizing work into short, iterative cycles with frequent feedback. They're standard in software and increasingly beyond it.
- [Communication](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/communication) — Communication is the ability to convey ideas clearly and listen well. It's consistently one of the most requested skills across every role and industry.
- [Leadership](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/leadership) — Leadership is the ability to guide, motivate and develop people toward a shared goal. It's essential for management roles across all industries.
- [Salesforce](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/salesforce) — Salesforce is the leading customer relationship management (CRM) platform. Sales, success and marketing teams use it to manage pipelines, accounts and campaigns.
- [Negotiation](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/negotiation) — Negotiation is the skill of reaching agreements that work for both sides. It's central to sales, procurement, management and everyday business.
- [Digital Marketing](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/digital-marketing) — Digital Marketing is the practice of promoting products through online channels like search, social, email and paid ads, guided by data.
- [SEO](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/seo) — SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is the practice of improving a website so it ranks higher in search results and earns organic traffic.
- [Google Analytics](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/google-analytics) — Google Analytics measures website and campaign performance. Marketers use it to understand audiences and optimize for conversions.
- [Content Writing](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/content-writing) — Content Writing is the craft of creating clear, engaging written content that informs audiences and supports marketing and communication goals.
- [Adobe Creative Suite](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/adobe-creative-suite) — Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) is the industry-standard toolkit for graphic and visual design.
- [Figma](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/figma) — Figma is the leading collaborative design tool for UI and product design. Designers use it to build wireframes, prototypes and design systems.
- [UX Design](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/ux-design) — UX Design is the practice of making products useful, usable and enjoyable by understanding users and designing their experience end to end.
- [Accounting](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/accounting) — Accounting is the practice of recording, classifying and reporting financial transactions. It's the foundation of finance roles and every business.
- [Financial Modeling](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/financial-modeling) — Financial Modeling is building spreadsheet models to forecast a company's performance and support decisions like budgeting, valuation and investment.
- [QuickBooks](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/quickbooks) — QuickBooks is the most popular accounting software for small and mid-sized businesses, used for bookkeeping, invoicing and reporting.
- [Customer Service](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/customer-service) — Customer Service is the skill of helping customers effectively and empathetically. It's essential across support, success, sales and retail.
- [Patient Care](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/patient-care) — Patient Care is the skill of safely and compassionately supporting patients' health and comfort. It's central to nursing and allied-health roles.
- [Supply Chain Management](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/supply-chain-management) — Supply Chain Management is the coordination of sourcing, production, inventory and logistics to deliver goods efficiently and reliably.
- [Problem Solving](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/problem-solving) — Problem Solving is the ability to break down complex situations, weigh options and reach effective decisions. It's one of the most universally requested skills across every industry.
- [Data Analysis](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/data-analysis) — Data Analysis is the skill of examining data to find patterns and support decisions. It's valuable far beyond tech — in finance, marketing, operations and healthcare.
- [Inventory Management](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/inventory-management) — Inventory Management is the skill of tracking and optimizing stock so a business has what it needs without waste. It spans retail, warehousing and supply chain.
- [Presentation](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/presentation) — Presentation is the skill of communicating ideas clearly and persuasively to an audience. It matters in sales, consulting, teaching and leadership.
- [Recruiting](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/recruiting) — Recruiting is the skill of finding, attracting and hiring the right people. It combines sourcing, assessment and relationship-building.
- [Employee Relations](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/employee-relations) — Employee Relations is the skill of maintaining fair, positive relationships between an organization and its people, handling concerns and conflict well.
- [Clinical Assessment](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/clinical-assessment) — Clinical Assessment is the skill of evaluating a patient's condition through observation, history and examination to guide care.
- [Prototyping](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/prototyping) — Prototyping is the skill of quickly building interactive mockups to test and communicate design ideas before they're built.
- [User Research](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/user-research) — User Research is the skill of understanding users' needs and behavior through interviews, surveys and testing to inform design.
- [Branding](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/branding) — Branding is the skill of shaping how an organization looks and feels so it's recognizable and trusted, from logos to voice.
- [TypeScript](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/typescript) — TypeScript is a typed superset of JavaScript that catches errors early and scales large codebases. It's increasingly standard for frontend and full-stack work.
- [Linux](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/linux) — Linux is the operating system that runs most servers and cloud infrastructure. Command-line fluency is essential for engineering, DevOps and security roles.
- [Sales Strategy](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/sales-strategy) — Sales Strategy is the skill of planning how to find, win and grow customers — from targeting and messaging to pipeline and forecasting.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/artificial-intelligence) — Artificial Intelligence is the field of building systems that perform tasks that normally require human intelligence — from language understanding to vision and decision-making. It's one of the fastest-growing areas of demand.
- [Deep Learning](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/deep-learning) — Deep Learning uses multi-layered neural networks to learn complex patterns from data. It powers modern computer vision, speech and language models.
- [Natural Language Processing](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/nlp) — Natural Language Processing (NLP) is how machines understand and generate human language. It underpins chatbots, search, translation and large language models.
- [Cloud Computing](https://hire-verified-talent-1.preview.emergentagent.com/skills/cloud-computing) — Cloud Computing is the delivery of computing — servers, storage, databases and AI — over the internet. Fluency with a major cloud platform is essential across modern tech roles.
